notes.title: Ver2.03.2 Update
notes.content:
Update has been performed.
Applications with "Ver 2.03.2" in the lower right corner of the title screen have been updated.

The stability of the save process has been improved.

If you have cleared the first game but the second game is not opened, please delete the saved data and restart the game.

The location where the save data is saved:
ShinLotionSamurai\ShinLotionSamurai_Data\SaveData\SaveData.dat
(Since save data may be restored by Steam Cloud, we recommend deleting the data while the game is running.
　It is recommended to delete the data while the game is running)

notes.title: Ver 2.03 update
notes.content:
Update has been performed.
Applications with "Ver 2.03" in the lower right corner of the title screen have already been updated.

Bug Fixes
Fixed a problem in which the player would move even though no time was added when kicking a destructive floor.
[b]Due to the large impact on time caused by the above-mentioned bug, the ranking of the 13th game has been switched. [/b]

　This problem mainly affects the difficulty level of the battle against Yoshimoto Imagawa in EX4-3.

notes.title: Ver 2.01 update
notes.content:
Update has been performed.
Applications with "Ver 2.01" in the lower right corner of the title screen have already been updated.

Enhancements】 【Functional enhancements
An option has been added to disable sound playback when the window is inactive.
　This can be changed from "Options" > "Games/Langage" > "Bag Ground Behavior".

Bug Fixes
Fixed a problem in which the instantaneous movement is disabled was ignored when a kick is performed at the moment of contact with the black lightning.
Fixed a bug that a part of EX2-2 had no wall judgment.

notes.title: Ver 2.0 Major Update
notes.content:
A major update has been performed.
Applications with "Ver 2.0" in the lower right corner of the title screen have already been updated.

Stage】 【Stage
Four extra stages were added.

Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug that the player would sometimes swing when kicking a wall during a hit stop.
Fixed a problem in which the game would progress with the pause menu displayed when performing seppuku in the pause menu.

Other
Achievements have been added.
A tweet button has been added to the results screen.
A tweet button has been added to the ranking screen.
The "Metabasu" on the title screen has been removed so that it will jump to the Twitter account of the Retsu Teikoku ().
　(https://twitter.com/Retsu324)

The ranking screen can be scrolled by the following operations on the ranking screen.

notes.title: Ver 1.11 Update
notes.content:
We have updated the software.
Applications with "Ver. 1.11" in the lower right corner of the title screen have already been updated.

Adjusted game balance.
5-1: The exploding ninja before taking the key has been changed to a white ninja.
5-1: Changed the explosive ninja to a white ninja before taking the key. 5-3: Placed a white ninja in front of the goal.
5-4: The attack frequency of the flame ninja was changed from 18 frames to 40 frames.
6-4: The path at the end of the game has been widened a little.
9-4: Added two white ninjas in front of the goal.
9-4: Added two white ninjas in front of the goal. 10-4: Removed mines in front of the goal.
13-4: Reduced the number of spikes on the top and bottom of the final board by 3.
14-4: Reduced the number of mines and spikes in the switch zone in the midfield.
15-1: Made the path in the water zone a little wider.
15-1: Added two white ninjas in front of Prince Shotoku.

Fixed a bug.
Fixed a bug that prevented the next stage from being opened after clearing a stage.
Fixed a bug that allowed players to skip stages if they followed certain steps.
Fixed a bug where the time registered in the ranking was different from the in-game time.

Other
Fixed a bug in the UI of the numbers that appear when you defeat an enemy.
Fixed a bug where the time registered in the ranking was different from the in-game time.
